title: From bytes to terabytes: how big is a file?
examples: How many megabytes in a gigabyte?
How many photos fit on my phone?

items.label: Terabyte
items.ask: How many photos fit in a terabyte?

explain.say: Have you ever seen your phone say storage almost full? Let us find out what it is counting. Look at the first block on the board: one byte. A byte is 8 bits, and it is enough to store one letter, like the letter A.

draw.text: From bytes to terabytes: how big is a file?

items.ask: How many photos fit in a terabyte?

explain.say: Now the next one: a kilobyte. Kilo means a thousand, just like a kilogram is a thousand grams. So a kilobyte is about 1000 bytes, enough for a short page of text. How many letters could fit in it?

items.label: Terabyte
items.ask: How many photos fit in a terabyte?

explain.say: Look at the megabyte. Mega means a million, so a megabyte is about a million bytes. One phone photo is often 2 to 4 megabytes. See how the board has to squash the blocks to fit? Each step is a thousand times bigger. What comes next?

items.label: Terabyte
items.ask: How many photos fit in a terabyte?

explain.say: Here are real things on the same ladder, in kilobytes. A short text message is tiny, a photo is a few thousand kilobytes, and a film is millions. Which one would fill your phone fastest?

Brilliant! A gigabyte is a thousand megabytes, and a terabyte is a thousand gigabytes. Wow fact: one terabyte could hold about 300 thousand phone photos, enough to take one photo every hour for over 30 years!

faq.a: A byte is a group of 8 bits. It can store one number from 0 to 255, which is enough for one letter or symbol of English text.
asks: How many bits in a byte?

faq.a: Both are used. In the official metric meaning a kilobyte is 1000 bytes. Some computers count in powers of two, where 1024 bytes is called a kibibyte. For everyday use, think of about a thousand.

faq.q: How many megabytes in a gigabyte?
faq.a: About 1000 megabytes make one gigabyte, and about 1000 gigabytes make one terabyte. Each unit is a thousand times bigger than the one before.
asks: What is bigger, MB or GB?

faq.q: How many photos fit in a terabyte?
faq.a: If a phone photo is about 3 megabytes, a terabyte, a million megabytes, holds roughly 300 thousand photos.
asks: How many pictures fit on 1 TB?

faq.q: Why does a film take so much space?
faq.a: A film is thousands of pictures per minute plus sound. Even squeezed with compression, an HD film is usually 1 to 4 gigabytes.
asks: How big is a movie file?

facts: In the metric (SI) system, kilo means 1000, mega 1 million, giga 1 billion and tera 1 trillion.
The IEC defines a kibibyte as 1024 bytes to avoid confusion with the 1000-byte kilobyte.

quiz.why: One gigabyte is about 1000 megabytes, far more than 5 megabytes or 900 kilobytes.

wrong.0: 5 megabytes is only about half of one percent of a gigabyte.
wrong.2: 900 kilobytes is less than one megabyte.

quiz.say: How many bits make one byte?
quiz.why: A byte is a group of 8 bits.

wrong.0: Two bits can only make 4 patterns, not a whole byte.
